old_value: {"id":"project-LICHEN-worker6-s6ml","title":"First-accept crash window permanently bricks an originator","description":"announce_store.rs accept() writes state then floor. The doc invariant (crash between writes leaves floor lagging, healed forward) only holds when a floor already exists. On the FIRST-ever accept for an IID, a crash or transient IO error on the floor write leaves (Some(state), None): load() returns Err(Corrupt) forever, accept() propagates it via self.load(iid)?, and there is deliberately no removal API — the originator is bricked short of manual file deletion. Fix: heal (Some, None) on first contact by writing floor := state — safe because the sealed state record is unforgeable under the seal threat model and a deleted floor cannot lower trust below it — or add a guarded recovery/tombstone API.
